tools.name: list_occasions
tools.title: List occasions
tools.description: Lists the occasions this group-card service supports, with the value to pass to create_board.

tools.name: suggest_prompts
tools.title: Suggest questions for participants
tools.description: Suggests ready questions the organiser can show participants, for an occasion. Optional recipientName fills the name in.

occasion.description: Occasion value from list_occasions, or a word like 'retirement'.

recipientName.description: Recipient's first name, to fill into the questions.

tools.name: occasion_date
tools.title: When is a holiday
tools.description: Next date and the one after for a professional day (Russian service) or a Jewish holiday (Hebrew service), computed from the calendar rule, never stale. For fasts and memorial days the answer says greetings are not customary.

occasion.description: Holiday id like 'avtomobilista' or 'yom-kippur', or its name.

tools.name: board_status
tools.title: Check collection progress
tools.description: Shows how collection is going for a card: how many have signed, when collection closes and when it opens. Takes the participants' invite link.

invite.description: The invite link (https://.../m/...) or its token.

tools.name: create_board
tools.title: Create a group card
tools.description: Creates a group greeting card that several people sign before it opens on a set date, and returns the link to send to participants. Requires the organiser's email: the full management links are sent there, and a one-time 'take control' link is returned. Ask the person for anything missing; never invent an email. For Дарим (darim.ai) names are Russian; for Yahad (yahad.ai) Hebrew.

recipientName.description: Who the card is for, as participants will see it.

occasion.description: Occasion value from list_occasions, or a word like 'retirement'.

revealDate.description: Date the card opens, YYYY-MM-DD, in the future.

organizerEmail.description: Organiser's email. Required; ask the person, never guess.

revealTime.description: Time the card opens, HH:MM, 24-hour. Default 18:00.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Moscow. Default: the service's own.

promptQuestion.description: Optional question shown to participants; see suggest_prompts.

recipientGender.description: Optional: 'female' or 'male', used for Hebrew grammar.

tools.name: gift_budget
tools.title: Split a group gift
tools.description: How much each person gives toward a group gift: divide the cost by those who will actually pay, round down; the organiser adds the rest. Or, from a per-person amount, the total budget. Pass exactly one of giftCost or perPerson. Amounts are in the service's currency.

giftCost.description: Total gift cost, in the service's currency.

payers.description: How many people will actually pay, 2 to 500.
